heading: Foster a good ecosystem for creators and users that encourages both the creation and adoption.

blocks.html: FOR USERS - Enhance user experience and engagement
Empower users to confidently interact with distinct AI characters.
Enable users to engage with their AI characters at various levels and capacities to maximize the quality of their interactions.
FOR CREATORS - Boost creator motivation and profitability
Educate and empower creators to understand the necessary steps to create diverse characters.
Equip creators with the right tools to empower them quickly monetize from their creations.
